name: OUTPUT_FILTER

ports.name: RECT_P
ports.meaning: Rectified positive rail from secondary synchronous rectifier FETs, typically 12-14V before filtering

ports.name: VOUT_SENSE
ports.meaning: High-impedance voltage sense point (through 1kΩ) for feedback and ADC monitoring

ports.name: ISENSE_P
ports.meaning: Positive current sense connection point, connects to shunt resistor in OUTPUT_SENSE_PROTECT block

description: Passive output filter for LLC converter. Provides bulk energy storage (2× 1000µF electrolytic) and high-frequency filtering (6× 47µF ceramic) for low output ripple. Includes output connector and sense taps.
